# Hacking HR

> The world's largest HR learning community empowering 2M+ professionals with AI-driven training, resources, and strategic HR leadership development.

Hacking HR is a comprehensive HR learning platform offering corporate training, professional development programs, and a vast knowledge hub of resources. The platform serves HR professionals at all levels, from individual contributors to CHROs, with a focus on modern HR transformation and strategic business partnership.

## Key Topics

- HR Learning Community
- Corporate Training
- AI Transformation
- HR Leadership
- CHRO & HRBP Development
- Global HR Capability Framework
- People & Culture Strategy
- HR Certification
- Cohort-Based Programs
- Strategic HR Business Partner
- Professional Development
- Future of Work
- HR Resources & Playbooks
- Workplace Trends
- People Analytics

## Core Platform

- [Hacking HR | Powering the Future of HR, Together](https://hackinghrlab.io): Homepage for Hacking HR, world's largest HR learning community with 2M+ professionals
- [Pricing & Memberships | Hacking HR](https://hackinghrlab.io/pricing): Membership tiers (Free, Premium, Premium+) with certification credits and AI tools

## Corporate Training & Development

- [Corporate HR Training & Capability Academies | Hacking HR](https://hackinghrlab.io/corporate-training): Custom in-house HR training and capability academies using Global HR Framework

## Resources & Knowledge Hub

- [HR Resources & Knowledge Hub | Hacking HR](https://hackinghrlab.io/resources): Free HR playbooks, workbooks, podcasts, and resources for modern HR professionals

## Support & Engagement

- [Contact Us | Hacking HR](https://hackinghrlab.io/contact): Contact page for inquiries about programs, partnerships, and community membership
